host_signals: synchronous to clk_i; ready/valid held until handshake
outer_reset: rst_ni asynchronous assertion, two-flop synchronized release for supervisor
inner_reset: supervisor coordinated cohort assertion after data obligations drain; existing two-flop synchronized release
endpoint_reset_requests: source/destination mask requests promote to whole cohort reset
cdc_status: not applicable to this single-clock instantiation; no asynchronous data crossing claimed
rdc_scope: explicit common-cohort reset contract; this static inventory is not a physical RDC/CDC signoff
future_multiclock: requires independent CDC FIFO/handshake, reset and credit-lifetime qualification
